name: Bóly (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bóly (a crowned blue shield with a yellow tower, bunch of grapes and a fish, within a wreath).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bóly arms with crown and wreath
